name: fl-design-system
description: Fission's own design system, end to end: fl-ds-new-project scaffolds a brand-new project in whatever framework and styling system the engineer picks (Next.js, React, Vue, Angular, Astro; Tailwind, shadcn, MUI, Bootstrap, Chakra, Ant Design, plain CSS/Sass) — on a framework Fission's design system actually supports (Next.js fully, React partially; nothing else, architecturally incompatible with shadcn/Radix), it's listed as a directly selectable styling option itself, not a buried follow-up question. fl-ds-setup then scaffolds or installs/updates it once chosen, and ten component skills (fl-ds-button, fl-ds-input, fl-ds-card, fl-ds-dialog, fl-ds-table, fl-ds-form, fl-ds-badge, fl-ds-select, fl-ds-tabs, fl-ds-toast) each check it's installed before using it, installing it on the spot if not. Fission's own system stays scoped and deliberate — no generic multi-brand component detection.
_schema_note: Verified against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference (checked 2026-10-09). No 'skills' array: the standard skills/ directory scan already covers all 12 skills here, and an explicit array only adds to that scan, so it would be a redundant hand-maintained duplicate.
